products.title: Dyno Proven
products.description: A rising horsepower curve sweeps off a dyno gauge under bold DYNO PROVEN lettering. For the builder who tunes with a laptop and proves it with numbers.

products.title: Fuel Injected
products.description: A stylized fuel injector with spray lines under FUEL INJECTED block type. For the builder who left the carburetor era behind and never looked back.

products.title: Restomod
products.description: A shield badge with RESTOMOD across the center and wrench-and-piston wings. Classic lines outside, modern running gear underneath.

products.title: Pro Touring
products.description: A sweeping road-course ribbon with PRO TOURING in speed-line type. Built to turn, stop, and go — not just sit.

products.title: Small-Block Swap
products.description: A V8 block with an engine hoist chain over SMALL-BLOCK SWAP lettering. The swap is the project; the tee says it out loud.

products.title: Overdrive
products.description: A gear-and-arrow motif under OVERDRIVE — highway legs for a vintage chassis. Cruises at 75, sips fuel like it means it.

products.title: Coilovers
products.description: A threaded shock absorber with spring coils around COILOVERS. Dialed in, corner weighted, ready for the next turn.

products.title: Four-Wheel Discs
products.description: A cross-drilled brake rotor with caliper over FOUR-WHEEL DISCS. Stops like a modern car, looks like a classic.

products.title: Standalone ECU
products.description: A control module with wiring-harness lines fanning out under STANDALONE ECU. The brain of the build — tuned, not guessed.

products.title: Wideband Tuned
products.description: An air-fuel gauge needle in the sweet spot under WIDEBAND TUNED. Tuned by the numbers, not by the seat of the pants.

products.title: Corner Carver
products.description: A car slicing through a switchback curve with CORNER CARVER speed type. For the driver who plans the weekend around the twisty road.

products.title: Boost Friendly
products.description: A turbo compressor wheel spinning under BOOST FRIENDLY. Power-adder ready — the block was built for it.

products.title: E85
products.description: A bold fuel-badge E85 with corn-stalk accents. Corn-fed horsepower — cheap octane, big smiles.

products.title: Data Log It
products.description: A jagged data-log trace across graph paper under DATA LOG IT. If it isn't logged, it didn't happen.

products.title: Street / Strip
products.description: A split badge — STREET on one side, STRIP on the other, divided by a Christmas tree light. Drives to the track, runs, drives home.

products.title: Modern Muscle Manners
products.description: A polite piston tipping its hat under MODERN MUSCLE MANNERS. Starts easy, idles smooth, runs hard — good manners, big power.

products.title: Modern Heart
products.description: A piston inside a heart outline with MODERN HEART below. Classic looks, modern heart — the restomod credo in one tee.

products.title: Roll Cage Ready
products.description: A triangulated roll-cage hoop graphic under ROLL CAGE READY. Built stout enough for the tech inspector's approval.

products.title: Tune It Right
products.description: A wrench crossing a laptop with a fuel curve over TUNE IT RIGHT. Measure twice, flash once.

products.title: Timing Is Everything
products.description: A distributor curve plot with spark lines over TIMING IS EVERYTHING. A few degrees is the difference between quick and quicker.

products.title: Fuel Map
products.description: A 3D fuel-map grid surface with FUEL MAP below. The tune lives in the table — this one is filled in right.

products.title: Ignition Advance
products.description: A spark plug throwing a big blue spark under IGNITION ADVANCE. Advance the timing, advance the cause.

products.title: Rev Happy
products.description: A tach needle pegged near the top under REV HAPPY. Built to breathe upstairs and happy to prove it.

products.title: Idle Smooth
products.description: A smooth cam-lobe sine wave under IDLE SMOOTH. Modern cam, modern manners — idles like it has nothing to prove.

products.title: Shift At Seven
products.description: A big numeral 7 with tach sweep under SHIFT AT SEVEN. The shift light's gospel, printed large.

products.title: Redline Respect
products.description: A redline arc badge with REDLINE RESPECT. Respect it and the engine lives; ignore it and buy pistons.

products.title: Dyno Day
products.description: A rollers-and-drum dyno graphic under DYNO DAY. Strap it down, spin it up, write down the numbers.

products.title: Power To The Pavement
products.description: Tire marks launching off the tee bottom under POWER TO THE PAVEMENT. All that tuning ends right here — at the contact patch.

products.title: Grip And Go
products.description: A tire tread block pattern with GRIP AND GO. Hook up, hold on.

products.title: Big Brakes
products.description: An oversized drilled rotor filling a wheel circle under BIG BRAKES. Speed is a question; stopping is the answer.

products.title: Adjustable Everything
products.description: A shock with clicker knobs and wrenches under ADJUSTABLE EVERYTHING. If it doesn't have a knob, it doesn't belong on the build.

products.title: Cammed And Tuned
products.description: A camshaft profile with lift dots under CAMMED AND TUNED. The cam sets the personality; the tune sets the manners.

products.title: Heads And Cam
products.description: A cylinder head with ports and a cam under HEADS AND CAM. The classic combo that wakes up any modern V8.

products.title: Bolt-On Build
products.description: A hex bolt head pattern under BOLT-ON BUILD. No machining, no drama — just weekends and wrenches.

products.title: Weekend Warrior
products.description: A calendar page circled SAT-SUN under WEEKEND WARRIOR. Monday through Friday pays for it; the weekend builds it.

products.title: Daily Driven
products.description: A sunrise-over-commute badge with DAILY DRIVEN. It runs the errands AND runs the numbers.

products.title: Modern V8 Swap
products.description: A clean V8 silhouette badge with MODERN V8 SWAP. New heart, old soul — the formula that never gets old.

products.title: Wired For Power
products.description: A wiring harness branching like a tree under WIRED FOR POWER. Every sensor home, every ground clean.

products.title: Coil On Plug
products.description: Eight coil packs in a row over COIL ON PLUG. No distributor to argue with — just fire on command.

products.title: Sequential Injection
products.description: Eight injector pulses in sequence under SEQUENTIAL INJECTION. Every cylinder gets its drink, right on time.

products.title: Closed Loop
products.description: A feedback-loop circular arrow with an O2 sensor under CLOSED LOOP. The computer listens, the engine behaves.

products.title: Knock Smart
products.description: A knock sensor puck with sound waves under KNOCK SMART. It hears what your ears can't — and pulls timing before it costs you.

products.title: Torque Management
products.description: A torque curve being shaped by a hand under TORQUE MANAGEMENT. Power is nothing without delivery.

products.title: Three Pedals
products.description: Three pedal pads — clutch, brake, gas — under THREE PEDALS. The manual swap is a statement, and this is it.

products.title: Six-Speed Swap
products.description: A six-gate shift pattern under SIX-SPEED SWAP. Six forward reasons to ditch the slushbox.

products.title: Row Your Own
products.description: A shifter lever mid-throw under ROW YOUR OWN. Nobody tunes your shifts for you — that's the point.

products.title: Launch Control

products.description: A brake zone marker board under BRAKE LATE. The fast guys make their time here — deep, smooth, committed.
